extDesc.message: Delay the current tab's audio in real time to fix lip-sync drift. The page player, seek bar and quality switching stay untouched.

actionTitle.message: Audio Delay Sync · Click to take over this tab

routeMseDesc.message: The player already decodes through MSE, so its audio segments pass through appendBuffer — reuse them as-is, no extra download.

routeCapDesc.message: Native HLS: pull back the ts segments the player already fetched over the debugging protocol — no extra download. The trade-off is the "being debugged" banner at the top of the browser, and it fails if you have DevTools open.

routeSrcDesc.message: Decode the same stream once more and keep only the sound. No permission, no refresh — but roughly double the download.

noticeAd.message: Ad break detected — sound pauses and resumes automatically afterwards

whyNoVideoEl.message: No video element found on this page.

whyNotLoaded.message: The video hasn't started loading. Press play, let it run a few seconds, then try again.

whyMediaStream.message: This page plays a live MediaStream, so its audio never goes through MSE. Bidirectional mode is unavailable; delay mode still works.

whyDash.message: This page uses a DASH (.mpd) manifest, so there is no audio channel to reuse. Bidirectional mode is unavailable; delay mode still works.

whyUnsupported.message: Bidirectional mode doesn't cover this kind of playback. Refresh the page and try again; if it persists, please report it.

toastGap.message: Audio segments keep landing out of order (gaps in the page's audio track) — sound may drop out occasionally

failNoAudioData.message: Couldn't capture usable audio, so bidirectional mode was dropped and the video's own sound is unchanged.

failCaptureAttach.message: Segment capture failed (debugger busy, or the page made no new segment requests) — degraded automatically

failCaptureFallback.message: No segments captured — switched to fetching a second stream (~2× data)

failSrcTimeout.message: Audio stream timed out, so bidirectional mode was dropped and the video's own sound is unchanged.

whyNoVideo.message: No video element found on this page

whyDirectMedia.message: The page loads media directly (.mp4, not .m3u8), so there are no segments to capture — the only option is a second stream

whyNoSegData.message: There is an m3u8 but no segment data could be read

hintWaitSeg.message: Audio segments haven't accumulated yet — let the video play a few seconds and try again.

hintWaitTrack.message: No audio track captured yet — let the video play a few seconds, then click.

toastStall.message: Buffer can't cover the advance — video paused while it downloads…

failResume.message: The video wouldn't resume, so bidirectional mode was dropped

failNoDataAtPos.message: Audio for this position hasn't downloaded — left bidirectional mode, sound is back to the page's own.

toastZeroAdvance.message: Buffer never caught up — the advance was reset to zero and only the delay is left.

toastLowerAdv.message: Buffer behind — safe advance lowered to

failDegradeSrc.message: Audio kept waiting for data — switched to fetching a second stream (~2× data)

toastDegraded.message: Not enough segments captured — degraded automatically

failMseSilent.message: Audio couldn't keep up with the picture — left bidirectional mode, sound is back to the page's own.

failDash.message: DASH (.mpd) isn't supported in bidirectional mode yet; delay mode still works.

tipEnhanced.message: Negative values pull sound earlier · scroll wheel to adjust

tipDelayOnly.message: Delay only · scroll wheel to adjust

tipEnableMse.message: Reuse the audio segments the page already downloaded — supports negative values (sound earlier)

tipEnableHlsMux.message: Native HLS: pull the player's already-downloaded segments over the debugging protocol, no extra traffic (the browser shows a debugging banner); falls back to a second stream if that fails

tipEnableHlsSrc.message: Native HLS: play the same stream once more (decoded by the browser) — supports negative values (sound earlier). Uses about twice the data

tipEnableSrc.message: Play the audio of the same stream once more (decoded by the browser) — supports negative values (sound earlier). Uses about twice the data

tipNoBiDash.message: The page's own player decodes this DASH (.mpd) manifest, so there is no audio channel to reuse. Delay mode still works

tipAuthRegistered.message: This site is already authorised, but the scripts weren't registered when this page loaded. One reload is enough

tipAuthNeed.message: Needs access to this site — clicking pops up the permission prompt

tipWaitTrack.message: The player hasn't written audio into MSE yet — let the video play a few seconds

tipWaitPlay.message: The video hasn't started loading — press play first

whyHlsDirect.message: The video URL is a direct .m3u8 (native HLS); the data never passes through JS

whyDirectNoMse.message: The video is loaded directly, so its audio never goes through MSE

errTakeover.message: Take-over failed for an unknown reason

uiStopCloseAria.message: Stop taking over and close the panel

uiSliderAria.message: Delay in seconds; negative values pull the sound earlier

actionTitleAuth.message: Click the icon to authorise bidirectional mode
